in_sanskrit.name: तुलसी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tulasi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'tulasi', which means 'the one who makes auspicious'. It is also the name of the sacred basil plant, which is considered holy in Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: तुलसी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tulasi is also known as 'Shubhkari' in Hindi, which means 'the one who brings good fortune'.

in_tamil.name: துலசி
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Tulasi is translated as 'Avō Aruviyal Vāṟkkirār', which means 'she who makes everything auspicious'.

in_telugu.name: తులಸీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, Tulasi is known as 'Shubhakāri', which means 'the one who brings good fortune'.

in_marathi.name: Tulasi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Holy Basil Plant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tulasi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tulasi is a holy basil plant that symbolizes devotion, purity, and is a sacred offering to Lord Vishnu. It is believed to bring good luck, ward off negative energies and is an essential part of Hindu rituals.
